gate_definitions.name: Sample
gate_definitions.definition: At least 30 graded plays; 10-29 is provisional, below 10 is unreadable.

gate_definitions.name: Calibration
gate_definitions.definition: Realised win rate within 8 points of the probability the originated line implied.

gate_definitions.name: Skill over the originated line
gate_definitions.definition: Exact Poisson-binomial one-sided p <= 0.05 for wins exceeding the model's own expectation.

gate_definitions.name: Multiple-comparison control
gate_definitions.definition: Benjamini-Hochberg q <= 0.10 across this library AND the shared-draw library null <= 0.05.

gate_definitions.name: Stability
gate_definitions.definition: Both halves of the window show a positive excess over the model, not just the pooled sample.

gate_definitions.name: Uncorrelated-bootstrap P&L
gate_definitions.definition: Moving-block bootstrap 95% interval for mean units has a lower bound above zero.

gate_definitions.name: Market test
gate_definitions.definition: Beats a real price after vig. BLOCKED for the whole repository: no NBA-operated source publishes one.

rows.name: Model favourite, edge >= 5 pts
rows.direction: wins MORE than its own line expected
rows.blocking_reason: every computable gate passed; only the market gate is left, and no NBA-operated source publishes a price, so it cannot be closed in this repository
